# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within OmniForge, please report it to **Ankur Gaurav** directly via GitHub ([https://github.com/ankur-gaurav161418](https://github.com/ankur-gaurav161418)).

All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
